name: Canadian buffaloberry
desc: A berry-bearing shrub of open forest. GloBI records show bears eating the berries and snowshoe hares eating the plant.
about: Shepherdia canadensis, commonly called Canada buffaloberry, russet buffaloberry, soopolallie, soapberry, or foamberry (Ktunaxa: kupaʔtiⱡ) is one of a small number of shrubs of the genus Shepherdia…
